metadata.title: Extropian Core
metadata.subtitle: The zero-dependency foundation of the Extropian ecosystem — 46 headers across four modules: core utilities, a pure sparse-set ECS with a shared SceneGraph, header-first math, and the document contracts everything renders.

sections.title: core/ — infrastructure
sections.subtitle: Self-contained exd::core utilities: allocators, pools, handles, hashing, logging, config, serialization, fs, and shared mesh contracts

nodes.label: LinearAllocator
nodes.desc: Bump allocator for per-frame scratch: 8-byte aligned by default, returns nullptr on overflow instead of throwing.

nodes.label: Pool
nodes.desc: Pool<T> fixed-size slot allocator with an O(1) free-list; the ECS stores each component type in one.

nodes.label: Handle
nodes.desc: Handle<T> generational handles — stable indices carrying version tags for safe reuse.

nodes.label: Hash
nodes.desc: FNV-style hashing used for ids, string keys, and config lookups across the platform.

nodes.label: Logging
nodes.desc: Thread-safe printf-style logging; Debug/Info/Warn go to stdout and Error to stderr.

nodes.label: Config
nodes.desc: Key-value Config store with typed get_or<T> access and TOML load/save.

nodes.label: Serialization
nodes.desc: Binary blob pack/unpack helpers plus json_escape; write/read_binary_file bridge to the fs layer.

nodes.label: FS
nodes.desc: Thin std::filesystem wrappers: file existence, read/write, directory listing, path helpers.

nodes.label: MeshTypes
nodes.desc: Vertex, PrimitiveTopology, MeshData, and Bounds contracts shared by the whole rendering stack.

sections.title: ecs/ — the entity component system
sections.subtitle: Pure sparse-set ECS: Registry owns component pools, views iterate, SceneGraph + TransformSystem derive world state

nodes.label: Entity
nodes.desc: Entity handle: id plus generation counter and optional name; equality compares id and gen only.

nodes.label: Component
nodes.desc: Component concept requiring trivially movable and destructible types; ComponentTraits assigns each type a runtime id.

nodes.label: Registry
nodes.desc: Sparse-set Registry: entity create/destroy, one type-erased Pool per component, typed view() queries.

nodes.label: View
nodes.desc: View<Cs...> iterates the smallest matching pool and filters the rest, with an .each() callback form.

nodes.label: CommandBuffer
nodes.desc: Deferred create/destroy/emplace mutations queued during iteration and applied at a sync point.

nodes.label: SystemGraph
nodes.desc: Phase-ordered execution of ISystem implementations over the Registry; TransformSystem runs in the Structural phase.

nodes.label: SceneGraph
nodes.desc: Generic parent-child containment with no semantics: attach/detach/reparent, DFS traversal, generation-safe prune.

nodes.label: Transform
nodes.desc: LocalTransform (authored TRS component) and WorldTransform (derived) — the shared transform model, math-backed.

nodes.label: TransformSystem
nodes.desc: Derives WorldTransform from SceneGraph relationships plus LocalTransform each update, cycle-guarded.

sections.title: math/ — vector & transform math
sections.subtitle: Header-only, SSE-friendly exd::math — vectors, matrices, quaternions, dual quaternions, bounds, raycast (plus Color and an umbrella math.hpp)

nodes.label: Vec2
nodes.desc: Vec2<T>: 2D vector with a scalar (wedge) cross product and up/right helpers for UV and UI math.

nodes.label: Vec3
nodes.desc: Vec3<T>: the platform workhorse — dot/cross, length, normalize, and axis constants like forward() (negative Z).

nodes.label: Vec4
nodes.desc: Vec4<T>: homogeneous coordinates and colors, with xyz() access to the first three components.

nodes.label: Mat3
nodes.desc: Mat3 column-major 3×3: from_axis_angle, from_scale, inverse, and mul_vec for linear transforms.

nodes.label: Mat4
nodes.desc: Mat4 4×4: perspective, look_at, TRS model matrices, and P·V·M composition.

nodes.label: Quat
nodes.desc: Quat rotation quaternions: from_axis_angle, from_rotation_matrix, and vector rotation via operator*.

nodes.label: DualQuat
nodes.desc: DualQuat rigid transforms: from_pose, decompose, to_mat4, and scLERP interpolation for skeletal animation.

nodes.label: Bounds3
nodes.desc: Bounds3<T> AABB with min/max and containment queries used for culling and picking.

nodes.label: Raycast
nodes.desc: Ray type plus Möller–Trumbore triangle, plane, sphere, and slab-method AABB intersection queries.

sections.title: types/ — the document contracts
sections.subtitle: The C++-only JSON schema: authored VisualDocument, semantic input, patches, sizing, style, and runtime presentation state

nodes.label: VisualDocument
nodes.desc: Authored 2D contract: metadata, canvas, sections, nodes, relations, data sources, and initial state — no resolved transforms.

nodes.label: SemanticDocument
nodes.desc: SemanticDocument: the concept-level input describing what exists, grounded by nodes' concept ids.

nodes.label: Patch
nodes.desc: VisualDocumentPatch: incremental structural mutations to the authored VisualDocument.

nodes.label: SizeSpec
nodes.desc: SizeSpec tokens (auto/fill/<n>/<n>%/<n>rem) resolved by layout consumers via exd::parse_size_spec.

nodes.label: StyleProfile
nodes.desc: StyleProfile: deterministic typography and spacing metrics so renderers resolve them without per-node baking.

nodes.label: PresentationState
nodes.desc: PresentationState: runtime UI state — StyleOverride, Annotation, AnimationClip, and PatchOp.

ecs-detail.title: Inside the Registry
ecs-detail.subtitle: Sparse-set storage, views, deferred mutations, and the ordered execution loop

nodes.label: EntityStorage
nodes.desc: Sparse set of alive entities with a free-list and generation counters for safe id reuse.

nodes.label: ComponentStorage
nodes.desc: Type-erased core::Pool<T> per component type, keyed by ComponentTraits runtime id.

nodes.label: View
nodes.desc: Typed iteration over the smallest pool with filtering of the other matching sets.

nodes.label: CommandBuffer
nodes.desc: Queues create/destroy/emplace operations while views are being iterated.

nodes.label: SyncPoint
nodes.desc: Applies buffered mutations to the registry at the sync boundary between passes.

nodes.label: SystemPass
nodes.desc: One execution slot running ISystem::update(Registry&, dt) in graph order.

nodes.label: ModeGating
nodes.desc: ISystem::active_modes() lets systems declare which runtime modes gate their update.

scene-graph-detail.title: SceneGraph + TransformSystem
scene-graph-detail.subtitle: A pure containment tree feeding derived world transforms

nodes.label: Attach
nodes.desc: attach/attach_at wire parent-child edges with ordered sibling placement.

nodes.label: Detach
nodes.desc: detach/remove/reparent/reorder/move_after mutate the containment structure.

nodes.label: Traverse
nodes.desc: Depth-first traversal with early abort, plus roots(), depth(), and traverse_all.

nodes.label: Prune
nodes.desc: Generation-safe prune of stale entities against the registry.

nodes.label: LocalTransform
nodes.desc: Authored TRS component relative to the parent; plain component state with no hierarchy semantics.

nodes.label: WorldTransform
nodes.desc: Derived accumulated local→world transform written by TransformSystem.

nodes.label: TransformSystem
nodes.desc: Accumulates TRS down the graph each update, cycle-guarded and generation-safe.

visual-document-detail.title: Inside VisualDocument
visual-document-detail.subtitle: The authored 2D contract: sections, nodes, relations, layout, and data in one picture

nodes.label: Document
nodes.desc: Root struct: version, id, metadata, canvas, density, composition, sections, nodes, relations, and data sources.

nodes.label: Canvas
nodes.desc: VisualCanvas: optional size, unit, aspect ratio, background, and grid resolution.

nodes.label: Section
nodes.desc: VisualSection: recursive named subtree with its own layout, nodes, and child sections.

nodes.label: Node
nodes.desc: VisualNode: kind, label, layout, content, shape, chart, binding, ports, and children.

nodes.label: Layout
nodes.desc: VisualLayout: presets stack/row/grid/split/overlay/flow plus constraints and explicit placement.

nodes.label: Relation
nodes.desc: VisualRelation: directed source→target edge with optional ports, label, and style.

nodes.label: DataSource
nodes.desc: DataSource feeds bindings: inline values, URIs, queries, or generated content.
